selection_rule: Validation only; for each seed error is sqrt(internal AvgRelRMSE * external AvgRelRMSE) against fixed No-Gain seed 42, and KCI is the arithmetic mean of internal and external percentages; average each over seeds 42,43,44. Within each family min-max normalize the five errors and KCI shortfalls, then choose the shortest equal-weight Euclidean distance to the minimum-error maximum-KCI ideal; ties: error then alias.

selection_details.normalization_note: Distances depend on the five candidates and are not comparable across families.
